description: React component for a customizable dialog/modal in the Notesnook mobile app, including event handling, input, and various UI elements.

methods.name: onPressPositive
methods.description: Handles positive button press, executes positivePress callback if provided, manages loading state, and closes dialog.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the dialog with provided DialogInfo data if the context matches.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Closes the dialog and resets state.

methods.name: onNegativePress
methods.description: Handles negative button press, calls onClose callback if provided, and hides the dialog.
